$description: Key Canadian tax credits, registered account limits, and system parameters for 2026.

tfsa.note: Cumulative room applies to someone 18+ in 2009 who has never contributed.

rrsp.formula: 18% of previous year's earned income, up to the annual limit; unused room carries forward indefinitely.

fhsa.note: Maximum single-year contribution is $16,000 ($8,000 annual + $8,000 carried forward).

credits.note: Federal non-refundable credits are valued at the lowest federal rate (14% in 2026). Provincial credits use each province's lowest rate.

oas.note: OAS recovery tax: 15% of net income above the threshold for the 2026 income year.

capital_gains.note: The proposed increase to a 2/3 inclusion rate was cancelled in March 2025; the rate remains 50%.

other.consumer_carbon_note: The federal consumer fuel charge (carbon tax) was ended effective April 1, 2025.
